title: My sci-fi extraction platformer has a free demo
author: dtlater
selftext:
I actually started this original setting as a TTRPG, then got so into writing the starter campaign that I pivoted to making a retro action platformer set in-world. The style is inspired by two of my favorite games, Mega Man X and Phantasy Star Online. 

Code and music were made with Claude Code, and the visuals with a local model workflow. I commissioned some character concept art and may commission music later.

The demo covers the first two levels on each of the four planets. Runs are short, and each level unlocks something cool. I'd like to fold in playtest feedback before I finish the rest.

Free and runs in the browser on PC or mobile.

https://omniu.itch.io/atom-scouts-nebula-demo

Also open to any feedback about the concept, visual style or gameplay, even if you just watch the trailer.
